When the Soldier enters, Blasting Station and Haliya trigger.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.

Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Koma, triggering Breath of Fury and Koma.
Resolve the Koma trigger, creating four creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat from step 2

803-5507-6871-6879.description:
Cast Inquisitive Puppet by paying {1}.
When Inquisitive Puppet enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, it and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Inquisitve Puppet trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Inquisitive Puppet as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Inquisitive Puppet by exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Inquisitve Puppet from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Inquisitive Puppet ability from step 5, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

3334-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Lae'zel.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
